responseLanguage.description: `automatico` (every account starts there) or the BCP-47 code explicitly chosen on the Account page.

detectedLanguage.description: The language detected from your own messages AND confirmed by you — never an unconfirmed detection. `null` until a confirmation exists.

effectiveResponseLanguage.description: What applies today OUTSIDE any session, and where it came from: account choice > confirmed detection > interface language.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
